task.ques: Search for an electric kettle on Amazon with a capacity of at least 1.5 liters, made of stainless steel, and with a customer rating of 4 stars or above.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: COMFEE’ Stainless Steel Electric Kettle meets all requirements: 1.7-liter capacity, stainless steel material (304 food-grade stainless steel inner pot and brushed stainless steel housing), and 4.6/5 customer rating from 16,839 reviews.
Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B084KQTCQW?th=1
Verified October 27, 2026. Evidence: final.png shows the product name, rating, capacity, and material together on Amazon’s product page.
